rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: RunReveal provides security log management and threat detection for cloud-native environments. Connects to over 70 security tools including AWS CloudTrail, Azure, Okta, Slack, and GitHub. Features AI-powered investigation capabilities, detection-as-code workflows, and real-time alerting. Built on ClickHouse for high-performance log analysis at scale.
